g.desc: {"kind":"workflow","id":"merge","title":"A change lands on main","subtitle":"and release-plz proposes a version","description":"Merging a change publishes nothing: it only updates the release PR.","steps":[{"id":"check","title":"CI checks the change","description":"[CI](#github.ci) runs fmt, clippy and the tests on the PR and again on `main`.","layer":1,"items":[{"edge":"(maintainer -> github.ci)[0]"}]},{"id":"propose","title":"release-plz updates the release PR","description":"The same push to `main` makes [release-plz](#github.releaseplz) bump the versions and changelogs in one PR.","layer":1,"items":[{"edge":"(maintainer -> github.releaseplz)[0]"},{"edge":"(github.releaseplz -> maintainer)[0]"}]}]}

{"kind":"element","path":"github.releaseplz","label":"release-plz","caption":"versions · changelogs","description":"Every push to `main` opens or updates a release PR. Merging it asks for [approval](#github.approval), then publishes. From `release-plz.toml`:
```toml
[workspace]
release_always = false
git_release_enable = false

[[package]]
name = "svugy-cli"
version_group = "svugy"
```"}

{"kind":"workflow","id":"publish","title":"A release is published","subtitle":"from the merged release PR to crates.io and GitHub","description":"Nothing is published before [the maintainer approves](#publish/approve).","steps":[{"id":"approve","title":"The maintainer approves the run","description":"Merging the release PR starts a run that waits on [the release environment](#github.approval), which holds the publishing secrets.","layer":1,"items":[{"edge":"(maintainer -> github.approval)[0]"},{"edge":"(github.approval -> github.releaseplz)[0]"}]},{"id":"crates","title":"release-plz publishes the crates","description":"[release-plz](#github.releaseplz) uploads every bumped crate to [crates.io](#cratesio).","layer":1,"items":[{"edge":"(github.releaseplz -> cratesio)[0]"}]},{"id":"binaries","title":"dist builds the installers","description":"The `svugy-cli` tag starts [dist](#github.dist). It creates the GitHub release only once all five targets are built, so [the latest release](#github.releases) always has installers.","layer":1,"items":[{"edge":"(github.releaseplz -> github.dist)[0]"},{"edge":"(github.dist -> github.releases)[0]"}]}]}
